Narrator.direction: Warm storyteller; let each image land

Sgt. Sprocket.direction: Seasoned field sergeant; dry confidence, connected instructions and firm sentence landings

Mags.direction: Bright, practical pilot; conversational, never breathless

Rook.direction: Quiet determination; make the decision count

Brann.direction: Grounded Forge engineer; generous breaths and dry humor

Seraphine.direction: Calm astronomer; reflective, with a faint crystalline double

Harbor Master.direction: Brisk officer, proud to join the fleet

76545485.speaker: Seraphine
76545485.text: The Ascendancy will stand with you. Even beside the Forge.

01d7d2e5.speaker: Brann
01d7d2e5.text: You saved my forge. You have my tracks, my tools, and my last good rivet.

0b1185bd.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
0b1185bd.text: Not bad rookie. Marshal Corvin will want to see you.

0c509b7e.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
0c509b7e.text: They saw you. Break the beam or get behind the ridge. You can still reach the prison.

0da5f06b.speaker: Narrator
0da5f06b.text: Brann's foundry is under siege. Clear the repair depot, then cut the supports feeding the Rust furnace.

0e5780bf.speaker: Marshal Corvin
0e5780bf.text: Stay with the caravan, Rook. We travel together.

102b7958.speaker: Mags
102b7958.text: Searchlights on the ridge. Switch your headlights off. A trench hides your hull; a shell into a tower base shuts its projector down.

1232e42d.speaker: Marshal Corvin
1232e42d.text: The Key can rewind the Mainspring. I will not let our worlds die because you are afraid of the price.

12a52bfb.speaker: Mags
12a52bfb.text: We're with you, Rook. Whatever comes next.

1630e437.speaker: Mags
1630e437.text: There's a lobber on the ridge. I can see it from here, so I'm marking it for you.

17028dc7.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
17028dc7.text: Never sit still when the ring's on you.

1747deb0.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
1747deb0.text: Contacts! Little ones. The planet curves away fast, so things pop over the horizon close. Your machine gun fires on its own at whatever your turret faces.

1cba3e1a.speaker: Marshal Corvin
1cba3e1a.text: And what's this... still warm. I'll keep this shard of the core. For study.

1d1d44de.speaker: Seraphine
1d1d44de.text: Aether is away. One fleet remains. Hold the harbor.

1e8800fa.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
1e8800fa.text: The caravan waits when you fall behind. Keep your front armor toward the sniper while reversing.

22e4ee56.speaker: Mags
22e4ee56.text: The Lantern burns bright. The worlds turn again. And we will be here to care for them.

25123c61.speaker: Narrator
25123c61.text: Seraphine is a prisoner in the frozen observatory. Cross the whiteout and silence its watchers.

253fdd26.speaker: Mags
253fdd26.text: Four exposed final drives. Break those brass hubs and the Crawler stops. The thick hull will just shrug it off.

262335e0.speaker: Brann
262335e0.text: Forge engines hot. Aether shields holding. Launch every ship!

288d056b.speaker: Mags
288d056b.text: All three worlds. One last launch. Let's make it count.

291b56d0.speaker: Narrator
291b56d0.text: Intercept the ore convoy before its cargo reaches Corvin's launch spire.

2c271dbf.speaker: Brann
2c271dbf.text: Depot online. Park here to repair.

2fe14c4e.speaker: Mags
2fe14c4e.text: It cannot move. The two mortar feeds are exposed. Cut them off before the next salvo.

32357e90.speaker: Seraphine
32357e90.text: The Lantern is not dying. It is waiting. I can show you another way.

32d1b70e.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
32d1b70e.text: Now you have a hole to hide in. Remember that.

331b4fd1.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
331b4fd1.text: Gravity is sixty percent of normal. Your familiar shots will travel farther.

364452d1.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
364452d1.text: Recovered Repair Kit. Good detour, Rook.

37c2d1a2.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
37c2d1a2.text: Craters are cover. Put a shell just in front of you. Not on your feet.

37dd2b4b.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
37dd2b4b.text: Repair at the depot before crossing to the furnace. Rust artillery can be silenced from beyond the curve.

3a54f0cc.speaker: Brann
3a54f0cc.text: Forge ships clear. Our pad is safe. Send me where you need the repairs.

3bdbbace.speaker: Narrator
3bdbbace.text: The Wright archive lies beyond an abandoned glassworks. Break the old chimney's footing to open a path.

3d9797a4.speaker: Narrator
3d9797a4.text: A siege battery is rolling toward the archive. Disable its outer defence, mortar pods and armored core.

3e3d418e.speaker: Narrator
3e3d418e.text: Range day at the Cradle depot. Sergeant Sprocket wants to see whether the new crew can drive, shoot and keep their heads down.

3f35148b.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
3f35148b.text: A shell at a structure's foot cuts the support and lets gravity do the work.

453fac0b.speaker: Brann
453fac0b.text: Or mend what our people built. There is still life in these worlds.

496d4309.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
496d4309.text: Keep the relay alive. Dig cover, watch the rings, and repair at the pad.

4d91471f.speaker: Marshal Corvin
4d91471f.text: Good work, Kestrel. Something's stirring at Millbrook. Get some rest; you ride at dawn.

515c0406.speaker: Mags
515c0406.text: The soil carries the weight. Put a shell at its foot.

564afaba.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
564afaba.text: Recovered Lantern Shard. Good detour, Rook.

5a280baf.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
5a280baf.text: Three practice targets. Point at one and fire. Big gun, big hole.

600b3b62.speaker: Mags
600b3b62.text: He took the Key. Rook... the regiment is following him. We're on our own.

66b98a06.speaker: Narrator
66b98a06.text: Millbrook has gone quiet. Marshal Corvin sends the Kestrel ahead of his column to hold the old mill until he arrives.

6730e65e.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
6730e65e.text: Scouts saw something past the ridge. Get to the lookout and have a look.

6778b0a3.speaker: Mags
6778b0a3.text: Mags Holloway, at your service. I'll stick to your flank. Try to keep up.

67f44de6.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
67f44de6.text: Aim low at the pontoon foundations. The harbor is a repair stop once captured.

694dfa23.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
694dfa23.text: Recovered Branns Rivets. Good detour, Rook.

6ee5aeb6.speaker: Narrator
6ee5aeb6.text: The Rust holds the dam and the old valley road. Break its supports, then bring down the Leviathan battery.

7247a56f.speaker: Harbor Master
7247a56f.text: Our ships are yours. Tidewell sails with the Kestrel.

7c08575f.speaker: Narrator
7c08575f.text: Low gravity has loosened the Halo's old anchors. Cut the Rust emplacements free and cross to the Mainspring approach.

7fdbf5a4.speaker: Narrator
7fdbf5a4.text: The free worlds launch together. Defend three launch pads while Forge, Aether and Tidewell prepare the fleet.

7ffb7ca9.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
7ffb7ca9.text: My turn. See the red ring? That's where my shell lands. Move!

8f7a865b.speaker: Narrator
8f7a865b.text: Win Tidewell's harbor. Break the Rust's shore batteries and recover the harbor master's charts.

9081d9ca.speaker: Narrator
9081d9ca.text: Seraphine marks the battery beyond the curve. Make a high arc reach the far-side guns before the fleet passes.

918c6e50.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
918c6e50.text: The launch spire is the destination. Destroy its footing and the convoy has nowhere to unload.

9247abc5.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
9247abc5.text: Two more, on your left! They've spotted you. Use the ground, a crater, anything!

95f05966.speaker: Marshal Corvin
95f05966.text: I only wanted the light to stay. Don't let it all have been for nothing.

9c703eb9.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
9c703eb9.text: Morning rookie. Let's see if this crate still rolls. Drive to the flag.

9db0ca57.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
9db0ca57.text: Attack the ground below each pylon. A crater that severs the foundation is the objective.

a431d2da.speaker: Mags
a431d2da.text: The pond is boiling... Something's coming up out of it!

a6901ead.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
a6901ead.text: That's the patrol. Back to the start line.

ad323b0f.speaker: Narrator
ad323b0f.text: The orchard depot has fallen. Recapture its repair pad and sever the foundations of three Rust Spires.

ad3a3299.speaker: Mags
ad3a3299.text: The worlds settle gently. Ahead of us, the Lantern. We sail together.

ae3b5b08.speaker: Rook
ae3b5b08.text: We mend it. Together. Turn the Key.

aefbddcb.speaker: Narrator
aefbddcb.text: Cross Amber Reach with Corvin's caravan. The wind carries shells across the canyon. Vex watches the rim.

b4d7d509.speaker: Narrator
b4d7d509.text: The lamp relay is our last voice to the regiment. Hold the hill until its message reaches Corvin.

b595e073.speaker: Seraphine
b595e073.text: We could let the worlds rest. Sail for the Lantern. Make something new.

b63ed601.speaker: Marshal Corvin
b63ed601.text: Hold your fire, the column's here. Well done, Rook. Better than I'd hoped.

bc642cd5.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
bc642cd5.text: Signal received. The regiment is coming. You kept the light on.

bdcd9787.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
bdcd9787.text: Long shots bend with radial gravity. The marker remains visible when the target crosses the horizon.

bfbfdb3f.speaker: Marshal Corvin
bfbfdb3f.text: Rook, Millbrook's gone quiet. Hold the mill until my column arrives. Mags is riding with you.

c1b134a7.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
c1b134a7.text: Save the big gun for the big ones.

c64a316d.speaker: Narrator
c64a316d.text: The Titan anchors its armor to the ice pylons. Cut away their support and finish the exposed battery.

c95be20f.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
c95be20f.text: The exposed brass drive housings are separate targets. Four drives, two mortar feeds, then the rear core.

c975e4ee.speaker: Marshal Corvin
c975e4ee.text: An archive older than the sun. Imagine what we might learn.

cf894d04.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
cf894d04.text: Last one moves. Lead it: aim where it's going to be.

d09d8a0e.speaker: Narrator
d09d8a0e.text: Corvin holds the Key. Break the Rustcrown, sever the core, and choose the future of the Orrery.

d31d41d0.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
d31d41d0.text: Something's lobbing at us from behind the curve! Watch the smoke trail. It comes from where the gun is.

d6cecea2.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
d6cecea2.text: The dam wall is thick. Its buttresses are exposed at the eastern and western footings.

d8a1387d.speaker: Rook
d8a1387d.text: Let it go. We carry our people forward, not the weight of the past.

d982d4bd.speaker: Mags
d982d4bd.text: Three launch pads. Assign us from the command panel. Keep a friendly vehicle on each pad for repairs, and clear the Rust before the countdown can continue.

d9e5cc45.speaker: Mags
d9e5cc45.text: They're coming over the ridge! I've got your flank.

dbe417e3.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
dbe417e3.text: Turn your headlights off. Stay out of the sweeping beams, use a ridge or trench as cover, or shell the projector bases. An alarm calls patrols but does not end the mission.

dd927ffc.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
dd927ffc.text: Guns silent. The furnace vent is open at the rear. Finish it, Rook!

dea78ea7.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
dea78ea7.text: Concrete protects the tower. Soil supports it. Attack the soil.

e13813e3.speaker: Mags
e13813e3.text: It isn't a plague. The Rust is a recycler. The Wrights built it to remake the worlds.

e9b36437.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
e9b36437.text: Assign each companion to a launch pad. Friendly vehicles enable repairs. Enemy vehicles contest the countdown. Move defenders as each fleet launches.

ec80a988.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
ec80a988.text: The relay pad repairs your hull. Dig cover before each wave and leave room to dodge.

eced6478.speaker: Narrator
eced6478.text: A first patrol past the depot. Scouts report movement beyond the ridge. On a world this small, the enemy is always just over the horizon.

efdeda60.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
efdeda60.text: The duel is only the beginning. Keep enough hull for the escape.

f6f13730.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
f6f13730.text: Recovered Mags Compass. Good detour, Rook.

f8545908.speaker: Sgt. Sprocket
f8545908.text: That one's hiding behind the wall. Shells fly in an arc, so lob one over.

fa01de03.speaker: Mags
fa01de03.text: It keeps spitting those little ones out. Take the big one down!
